notes.1.8: Line 8: zꜣ=f may be 'his son' rather than 'his protection', and r-ḥꜣ may be 'outside'. Line 12: sd(?)ꜣ,w, 'terror', and šmꜣm,wyt, 'displeasure', are uncertain. Line 14: ꜥnḫ is taken as 'oath (by his life)'.

nodes.text: His protection is around the one who proclaims his might.
He is Khnum for everyone, the begetter who brings the people into being.
He is Bastet, who protects the Two Lands.
He is Sekhmet [to] the one who transgresses what he has commanded.
[His] terror(?) is against the one who is under his displeasure at night.
